summary: San Francisco Bay Area, software developer, strong libertarian beliefs, advocates for free speech and privacy rights, critical of government regulation and corporate influence, long-time user of Firefox since version 1, active in open-source communities, critical of DRM and EME in web standards, supports data ownership rights, skeptical of mainstream media narratives, interested in technology and its implications on society, prefers minimal human interaction in shopping, advocates for basic income and welfare reform, critical of the war on drugs and civil asset forfeiture, believes in the importance of user-centric open-source software.
